summary: v0.7.0 native review: I read the code changes between commits 42aa12d0 and d908f674 and ran the JVM suite and backend checks. There is no emulator, so nothing ran on a device. Gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest + :app:assembleDebug: BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 136 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 1 skip (hardware Keystore); app-debug.apk is in build/outputs. Frontend baseline: 515 entries, missing=0, mismatches=0. Backend private download: 25/25 passed, and the token was never printed. Autoplay resolve flow, movie CTA/Swap count, series DetailScroll/season rail/episode cards, the shared initial Deferred and page accounting, and the TrailerCache fail-safe flag are all correct as written. One issue works against the user's 'rows below the fold as fast as V2' request: HomeScreen prefetches rows one at a time. The other findings are minor.

ui_bugs.issue: Rows below the fold are prefetched one at a time: `adapters.forEach { ...prefetch(context).join() }`. Each ShelfAdapter/PreviewRowsAdapter holds one row, so row N's network request only starts after rows 1..N-1 finish. Before any prefetch starts, the code also waits for the hero `repository.catalog(cat)` call on line 85. Rows deeper down (New movies / New series, Upcoming, custom) still arrive late. If the hero fetch throws, the outer catch shows 'Couldn't load your catalogues.' and no prefetch happens at all. Fix: start every prefetch at once (`adapters.mapNotNull{ when(it){is ShelfAdapter->it.prefetch(context); is PreviewRowsAdapter->it.prefetch(context); else->null} }` with no join), placed BEFORE the hero fetch, and wrap the hero fetch in its own try/catch.

This was already broken before v0.7.0 (since v0.5.0). The second `setOnKeyListener` (keyAction) replaces the first one, so the explicit DPAD_UP-to-upTarget handling on first-row tiles never runs. The comment above it says nested RecyclerView focusSearch can ignore nextFocusUpId. Fix: merge both into one listener.

The grid is capped at 5 columns. With 6 or more profiles there are 2 rows (~2x182dp). Estimated total height is ~610dp, which is more than the 540dp TV viewport, and nothing scrolls, so the actions row (Browse/Sign out) is clipped. Tile margins `setMargins(8,8,8,8)` are raw px, not dp.

integration_issues.issue: Nothing stops a second launch. A fast double DPAD_CENTER on 'detail-play' (Autoplay) or on an episode card calls MainActivity.autoplay twice, which launches two PlayerActivity instances. pendingAutoplay is overwritten, so only the last result is handled. A tile tap does NOT double-launch: the `launched` flag guards both the init path and the load() path. Suggest ignoring autoplay() while a launch is in progress (e.g. while pendingAutoplay != null), and clearing it in the result callback.

After the activity is recreated, resolve() sets selected=first and ignores savedInstanceState 'selected', so a stream the user switched to is lost. After process death StreamPrefetch is empty, so peek() returns null and the player finishes with RESULT_CHOOSE_STREAM. The recreated MainActivity has pendingAutoplay=null, so the fallback to the stream list is silently dropped. These are edge cases; TV rarely recreates activities.

critical_code_review_comments: ShelfAdapter.load (line 62) and PreviewRowsAdapter.load: `catch (e: Exception) { state.initial = null; throw e }` also catches CancellationException when a holder is recycled mid-await. That throws away the shared in-flight Deferred (which keeps running, orphaned), and the next bind sends the same page-1 request again. Rethrow CancellationException before resetting. Paging is correct: offset/page start at 0/1, use initial, then increase by page.size/1, so rows neither duplicate nor skip page 1.

TrailerCache.preload: CacheWriter.cache() blocks and is not cancellable through coroutine cancellation. Jobs in TrailerPreview.preloads are never cancelled on stop/dispose, and the 2-slot semaphore is shared. Up to ~1.85MB per neighbouring trailer can compete for bandwidth with the trailer that is actually focused. Suggest keeping the CacheWriter and calling cancel() from invokeOnCompletion, and cancelling preloads in stop(true). Playback is protected: errors are caught with runCatching, FLAG_IGNORE_CACHE_ON_ERROR is set, the SimpleCache singleton is double-checked/@Volatile, and locked spans fall back to upstream.

TrailerPreview now plays through OkHttpDataSource on the shared client with the default 'okhttp/x' User-Agent, where it used to use DefaultHttpDataSource's ExoPlayer UA. This is low risk, but if some googlevideo/TMDB hosts start returning 403, look at UA parity first.

Hero fetch (HomeScreen:85) and ShelfAdapter.initial for the first catalog can both hit the network for the same skip=0 page when they run at the same time. CatalogRepository only de-duplicates once a request has finished.

DetailScreen: the 'detail-autoplay' pill object is still constructed for movies but never added (fine, the test asserts it's absent). For series, playButton/swapButton are built but unused. The movie CTA label and whether swapButton is shown are fixed at construction and don't follow pref changes made while the screen is in the back stack.

No unguarded API >26 calls in the changed files. setFontVariationSettings is API 26. Typeface.create(tf,900,false) and outlineSpot/AmbientShadowColor are guarded by SDK_INT>=28. java.time.Instant needs API 26, which equals minSdk.

Estimated layout at 960x540dp: the login form is ~410-445dp tall (fits), the PIN panel fits, and series DetailScroll places the episodes at ~403dp, then centres the focused card. AdaptiveDetailLayout still shrinks the lane to the viewport (`min(160, height-laneTop-12)`) instead of letting the page scroll, so with very large accessibility text the lane could be compressed.
action_items: HIGH: In HomeScreen.load, start all row prefetches at once (no .join() in the forEach) and before the hero fetch; isolate hero fetch failures in their own try/catch.
MEDIUM: Merge the two setOnKeyListener calls in TitleAdapter.onBindViewHolder so first-row DPAD_UP reaches the upTarget again.
MEDIUM: Ignore repeat autoplay() calls while a launch is pending, so a double press can't start two PlayerActivity instances.
LOW: Rethrow CancellationException before `state.initial=null` in ShelfAdapter/PreviewRowsAdapter load().
LOW: Make TrailerCache precache cancellable (CacheWriter.cancel) and cancel preloads in TrailerPreview.stop(true).
LOW: Make the ProfilePicker scroll, or limit grid height, when there are 6+ profiles; convert the raw-px tile margins to dp.

success_rate.backend: 100% (25/25 download tests; 136/136 JVM tests, 1 hardware skip)
